kurz: The puffed-up coating forms because steam from the meat lifts the breadcrumbs while they turn crisp in the hot fat.
bild_im_kopf: Like a tent billowing up over the meat.

schluesselmomente.warum: Thin meat is cooked before the coating burns.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Flour, egg, breadcrumbs, without pressing them on
schluesselmomente.warum: A loose coating can lift away from the meat and form waves.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Fry floating in plenty of hot fat, swirling the pan
schluesselmomente.warum: Hot fat runs over the top. Steam from the meat puffs up the coating.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Drain briefly on kitchen paper or a rack
schluesselmomente.warum: Draining stops the coating from drawing in more fat.
